data.gender_notes: Navami is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Navami refers to the ninth day or the ninth avatar of Lord Vishnu. In Hindu mythology, the ninth day of each lunar fortnight holds great significance. The name Navami carries the meaning “Ninth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Navami usually hope their child will grow to embody ninth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes devotion and commitment towards spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Navami belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ninth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Navami total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
